ReturningParseOk.doc: Successful parse of a (possibly absent) RETURNING clause: the list of result columns (empty if no clause was present) and the index of the next token after the clause.

parse_returning_opt.doc: Parse an optional `RETURNING <result_column> [, ...]` tail. If the token at `start` is not `KwReturning`, return an empty list and the unchanged index. Otherwise consume the keyword, parse one-or-more comma-separated result columns (Star / TableStar / Expr-with-optional-alias), and return them along with the position of the first token past the clause. Used by insert-stmt, delete-stmt, and update-stmt.
